description: Answers 'would this strategy have worked - without look-ahead or survivorship bias?' Give a JSON spec (universe as a symbol list or top500/top1000/top3000/all, start, end, signal, rebalance D/W/M/Q, top_n, costs_bps, side long or long_short, blind=true to hide tickers). Signals: momentum, ma_cross, factor, or expr formulas over prices and point-in-time fundamentals (from 2011), e.g. 'rank(ret(252)) - rank(vol(60))'. Returns stats, benchmark stats, equity curve, warnings, snapshot id, an overfitting report (trials counted, deflated Sharpe) and a disclaimer. Prices are point-in-time with a 400-day buffer, clipped to as_of; identical specs on the same snapshot are cached and free. Free keys backtest the last 12 months; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

dry_run.description: true: check the spec and report what would run and what it would cost, without running it or charging. Default false.
